exposure: Emirati/Omani vs. other nationalities (e.g., Egyptian, other Arab)
Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) vs. elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS)
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 263 women eligible for VBAC at a hospital in the UAE
finding: Cultural background significantly influenced VBAC acceptance and success rates, with higher rates among Emirati/Omani women opting for TOLAC compared to other nationalities.
mod_finding: TOLAC was associated with lower NICU admissions and maternal readmissions compared to ERCS.
